_comment: tradeskill_recipes.json - every crafting recipe keyed by recipe_id (Scripts/tradeskill_window.gd). 'stations' lists every station id the recipe can be made at; a group id in ingredients (e.g. cooked_meat_any) matches any item listed under that key in 'ingredient_groups'. Generated by tools/export_crafting.py from Crafting.xlsx - do not edit by hand; edit the workbook and re-run.

cook_cooked_meat.name: Cooked Meat
cook_cooked_meat.craft_message: You hold the meat over the fire and it becomes a cooked hunk of mystery meat. It beats nothing, but just barely.

cook_cooked_bat_meat.name: Cooked Bat Meat
cook_cooked_bat_meat.craft_message: The bat meat is delicate and cooks in moments. The smell is surprisingly pleasant.

cook_cooked_rat_meat.name: Cooked Rat Meat
cook_cooked_rat_meat.craft_message: The small rat meat cooks quickly over the fire, releasing a savory aroma. Soon it's ready.

cook_cooked_spider_meat.name: Cooked Spider Meat
cook_cooked_spider_meat.craft_message: You hold the spider meat over the flames. It hisses and pops, releasing an acrid smell. Once cooked through, it's ready to eat. The meat is tough and chewy, like the desert itself - but it sustains you.

cook_cooked_snake_meat.name: Cooked Snake Meat
cook_cooked_snake_meat.craft_message: You skin the viper and roast it over the coals. It curls as it cooks, and smells better than you expected.

cook_cooked_goblin_meat.name: Cooked Goblin Meat
cook_cooked_goblin_meat.craft_message: The goblin meat is thick and heavy. It sears with a deep brown crust. The smell is... complex. But filling. You've killed goblin raiders. Now you eat them. Waste nothing in the desert.

cook_cooked_human_meat.name: Cooked Human Meat
cook_cooked_human_meat.craft_message: Human: "You killed a bandit. You need to eat. The desert doesn't judge."  Troll: "Soft human meat. Much better than spider. Your kind knew how to hunt."

cook_desert_thistle_salad.name: Desert Thistle Salad
cook_desert_thistle_salad.craft_message: You mix the cooked meat with fresh thistle blooms. The combination is surprisingly pleasant—savory meat with floral notes.

cook_sandroot_stew.name: Sandroot & Meat Stew
cook_sandroot_stew.craft_message: The stew simmers over the fire, steam rising with an earthy aroma. The sandroot dissolves into the broth, enriching it.

cook_viper_kebab.name: Fire-Roasted Viper Kebab
cook_viper_kebab.craft_message: You skewer the snake meat and hold it over dancing flames. The venom cactus flower releases a purple smoke as it cooks. The aroma is intoxicating and dangerous.

alch_basic_poison.name: Basic Poison
alch_basic_poison.craft_message: The thistle extract bubbles as you add spider venom. The mixture turns a sickly yellow-green.

alch_viper_poison.name: Viper Poison
alch_viper_poison.craft_message: The cactus flower dissolves as snake venom is introduced. The reaction is violent—steam rises and the mixture glows ominous red.

alch_minor_healing_potion.name: Minor Healing Potion
alch_minor_healing_potion.craft_message: The potion turns soft amber, glowing faintly with healing energy.

alch_antidote_essence.name: Antidote Essence
alch_antidote_essence.craft_message: You carefully balance the venom cactus with healing herbs. The mixture turns neutral grey-green. When drunk, every poison burns away harmlessly.

alch_stamina_elixir.name: Stamina Elixir
alch_stamina_elixir.craft_message: The venom cactus flowers release their essence and the potion becomes electric blue, vibrating with contained energy.

alch_moonpetal_essence.name: Moonpetal Essence
alch_moonpetal_essence.craft_message: The Moonpetal Sage dissolves and the potion glows with soft silver light. The air smells of starlight and ancient magic.

alch_elixir_of_insight.name: Elixir of Insight
alch_elixir_of_insight.craft_message: The Moonpetal Sage glows as you prepare it with sandroot. The final potion is crystal clear, like liquid starlight.

brew_desert_tea.name: Desert Tea
brew_desert_tea.craft_message: You steep the thistle flowers in hot water. The brew is pale gold and smells fresh. A sip refreshes you. The first tea you learned to make. Now it's the taste of the desert itself.

brew_energy_brew.name: Energy Brew
brew_energy_brew.craft_message: The venom cactus creates a tingling sensation as you drink. Your senses sharpen and your movements feel faster.

brew_courage_draught.name: Courage Draught
brew_courage_draught.craft_message: The brew is dark and intense. Drinking it fills you with confidence and aggression.

brew_fortified_tonic.name: Fortified Tonic
brew_fortified_tonic.craft_message: The sandroot infuses the brew with earthy power. It tastes medicinal but effective.

brew_resistance_elixir.name: Resistance Elixir
brew_resistance_elixir.craft_message: The brew glows slightly with protective energy. It tastes bitter but effective.

brew_clarity_draught.name: Clarity Draught
brew_clarity_draught.craft_message: The brew is clear as starlight. Drinking it makes the world seem sharper, clearer, more understandable.

brew_starlight_cordial.name: Starlight Cordial
brew_starlight_cordial.craft_message: The cordial glows faintly with ethereal light. Its taste is complex—sweet, bitter, mysterious. Drinking it feels sacred.

tink_cog_trinket.name: Tinkered Cog Trinket
tink_cog_trinket.craft_message: You hammer two bits of scrap into something that ticks when you shake it. Somehow it feels lucky.

tink_tinkered_spring.name: Tinkered Spring
tink_tinkered_spring.craft_message: You carefully coil copper into a perfect spring. It bounces with satisfying energy in your hand.

tink_copper_pickaxe.name: Copper Pickaxe
tink_copper_pickaxe.craft_message: You forge the copper head and attach it to a wooden shaft. The tool feels balanced and ready to bite into stone.

tink_copper_wrist_cuff.name: Copper Wrist Cuff
tink_copper_wrist_cuff.craft_message: You shape the copper around a leather backing. It fits snugly around the wrist, warm from your hands. As you fasten it, you feel slightly more confident.

tink_smoke_grenade.name: Smoke Grenade
tink_smoke_grenade.craft_message: You pack copper shavings and dried thistle into a small housing. It feels slightly warm to the touch, like something waiting to happen.

tink_copper_lantern.name: Copper Lantern
tink_copper_lantern.craft_message: You fit the spring-loaded wick trimmer and close the little copper hood. The flame inside burns small, steady and patient.

tink_bronze_woodcutters_axe.name: Bronze Woodcutter's Axe
tink_bronze_woodcutters_axe.craft_message: You craft the bronze head with care, then secure it to an ironwood haft. The weight feels right—this is a tool that will last.

tink_bronze_charm.name: Bronze Charm
tink_bronze_charm.craft_message: The bronze wraps around the stone perfectly, securing it with delicate metalwork. Warmth spreads through your fingers. The stone seems to hum gently.

tink_explosive_device.name: Explosive Device
tink_explosive_device.craft_message: You carefully pack bronze shavings, venom cactus powder, and a coiled spring into a reinforced container. This is either going to be brilliant or hilarious. Or both.

tink_bronze_lockpick_set.name: Bronze Lockpick Set
tink_bronze_lockpick_set.craft_message: You carefully shape five different bronze picks, each one a work of precision. These will open many doors.

smith_tin_ingot.name: Tin Ingot
smith_tin_ingot.craft_message: The tin ore glows as you heat it in the forge. It melts smoothly, flowing into the mold like liquid silver.

smith_tin_dagger.name: Tin Dagger
smith_tin_dagger.craft_message: You hammer the tin ingot into shape, creating a small but functional blade. You wrap fir wood around the handle for grip. Your first weapon, forged in the desert heat. It's not much, but it's yours.

smith_tin_shortsword.name: Tin Shortsword
smith_tin_shortsword.craft_message: You forge two ingots into a proper blade, balancing weight and sharpness. The leather-wrapped handle fits perfectly in your grip.

smith_copper_ingot.name: Copper Ingot
smith_copper_ingot.craft_message: The copper ore transforms in the heat, becoming a beautiful reddish-orange ingot. You can feel the quality in it.

smith_copper_sword.name: Copper Sword
smith_copper_sword.craft_message: The copper takes shape under your hammer, becoming a beautiful blade with a natural shine. The ironwood handle is strong and comfortable.

smith_copper_axe.name: Copper War Axe
smith_copper_axe.craft_message: You forge a wide, heavy head on a long ironwood handle. This is a weapon that demands respect and strength to wield.

smith_copper_armor_plating.name: Copper Armor Plating
smith_copper_armor_plating.craft_message: You craft multiple pieces of copper plate, fitting them together with leather straps. The armor feels protective without being overwhelming.

smith_bronze_ingot.name: Bronze Ingot
smith_bronze_ingot.craft_message: You melt the copper and stir in the tin. The alloy flows golden-brown and cools with a deep sheen—this is quality metalwork.

smith_bronze_shield.name: Bronze Shield
smith_bronze_shield.craft_message: You craft a bronze face and reinforce it with an ironwood frame. The shield is heavy but balanced, ready to protect its bearer.

smith_bronze_longsword.name: Bronze Longsword
smith_bronze_longsword.craft_message: You pour your skill into this blade. The bronze glows as you hammer it, taking the perfect shape. The gem you set catches the light beautifully. This is a work of art.

ww_fir_planks.name: Fir Planks
ww_fir_planks.craft_message: You carefully work the fir wood, sawing and shaping it into uniform planks. The wood is soft and compliant, yielding easily to your tools.

ww_pitch_torch.name: Pitch Torch
ww_pitch_torch.craft_message: You wrap the linen tight around the fir and work the pitch in with your thumbs. It catches on the first spark.

ww_fir_firewood_bundle.name: Fir Firewood Bundle
ww_fir_firewood_bundle.craft_message: You split the fir into kindling and lash it together with the flint tucked inside. Enough for a small fire and a short rest.

ww_fir_shortbow.name: Fir Shortbow
ww_fir_shortbow.craft_message: You bend the fir wood carefully and string it. It's simple, but it works.

ww_fir_staff.name: Fir Staff
ww_fir_staff.craft_message: You shave a long fir plank smooth and wrap the grip. It's light, and it hums faintly when you channel through it.

ww_ironwood_planks.name: Ironwood Planks
ww_ironwood_planks.craft_message: You work the ironwood carefully, using precise sawing technique. The wood resists your tools but yields beautifully finished planks with rich dark grain.

ww_ironwood_bow.name: Ironwood Bow
ww_ironwood_bow.craft_message: The ironwood bow is darker, stronger. You can feel the power in it as you string it. This bow will last and perform.

ww_ironwood_torch.name: Ironwood Torch
ww_ironwood_torch.craft_message: The ironwood takes the oil slowly. When it finally catches, the flame is steady and hot, and it barely seems to burn down.

ww_ironwood_firewood_bundle.name: Ironwood Firewood Bundle
ww_ironwood_firewood_bundle.craft_message: The ironwood splits reluctantly. It'll burn for hours once it's going.

ww_ironwood_staff.name: Ironwood Staff
ww_ironwood_staff.craft_message: The ironwood fights your blade the whole way, but the finished staff is heavy, straight and true.

ww_palm_planks.name: Palm Planks
ww_palm_planks.craft_message: You work the palm wood with reverence, preserving its natural beauty as you shape it into perfect planks. The golden hue deepens as you finish each one.

ww_palm_resin_torch.name: Palm-Resin Torch
ww_palm_resin_torch.craft_message: The resin hardens into a glassy shell over the wrap. The flame burns gold and doesn't so much as flicker in the wind.

ww_palm_longbow.name: Palm Longbow
ww_palm_longbow.craft_message: You craft this bow with reverence. The golden palm wood is warm to the touch. The silk string is smooth and strong. This is a weapon worthy of a master archer.

ww_palm_firewood_bundle.name: Palm Firewood Bundle
ww_palm_firewood_bundle.craft_message: The palm wood smells of the oasis as it burns. Everyone near the fire seems to stand a little straighter.

ww_masters_staff.name: Master's Staff
ww_masters_staff.craft_message: You set the gem into the bronze crown and feel the staff wake in your hands, warm as a living thing.

fle_bowstring.name: Bowstring
fle_bowstring.craft_message: You twist the thread tight, wax it, and give it a test pluck. It sings.

fle_quiver_fir_arrows.name: Quiver of Fir Arrows
fle_quiver_fir_arrows.craft_message: These arrows are more refined. Better balanced, better tipped. A step above the vendor's rough arrows.

fle_broadhead_arrowheads.name: Broadhead Arrowheads
fle_broadhead_arrowheads.craft_message: You knap the flint and bind it in copper. These heads will hit with devastating force.

fle_quiver_ironwood_arrows.name: Quiver of Ironwood Arrows
fle_quiver_ironwood_arrows.craft_message: The ironwood shafts are beautiful—dark and strong. The copper tips glint in the sun. These are arrows to be proud of.

fle_silk_bowstring.name: Silk Bowstring
fle_silk_bowstring.craft_message: The blighted strand is cold and slick in your fingers. Braided in, it gives the string a strength that feels almost unnatural.

fle_quiver_broadhead_arrows.name: Quiver of Broadhead Arrows
fle_quiver_broadhead_arrows.craft_message: You fit each shaft with a broadhead and test the edge on your thumb. You bleed. Good.

fle_quiver_palm_arrows.name: Quiver of Palm Arrows
fle_quiver_palm_arrows.craft_message: You craft each arrow with precision. The golden palm shafts are beautiful. These arrows deserve a worthy bow.

jc_polished_gem.name: Polished Gem
jc_polished_gem.craft_message: You carefully polish the raw gem on a sandstone block. Its beauty reveals itself as the rough edges fall away.

jc_tin_ring.name: Tin Ring
jc_tin_ring.craft_message: You shape the tin into a delicate ring. It's simple but elegant.

jc_simple_amulet.name: Simple Amulet
jc_simple_amulet.craft_message: You craft a small tin pendant, set a snake scale in it, and string it on soft leather. It sits comfortably against the chest.

jc_copper_ring.name: Copper Ring
jc_copper_ring.craft_message: The copper glints as you set the gem. This ring has real quality to it.

jc_gem_setting.name: Gem Setting
jc_gem_setting.craft_message: You mount the polished gems in a copper setting with precision. This is ready for installation.

jc_copper_pendant.name: Copper Pendant
jc_copper_pendant.craft_message: The copper pendant hangs from a fine thread cord. The gem catches the light beautifully.

jc_bronze_ring.name: Bronze Ring
jc_bronze_ring.craft_message: You carefully craft this ring with precision. The gem is beautiful and valuable. This ring is a treasure.

jc_bronze_amulet.name: Bronze Amulet
jc_bronze_amulet.craft_message: You craft this amulet with reverence. The gem glows softly. The pale silk cord shines like captured moonlight. This is a piece of art.

lw_soft_leather.name: Soft Leather
lw_soft_leather.craft_message: You treat the raw hide with tanning oil, working it until it becomes supple and ready. The smell is strong but the leather is perfect.

lw_leather_jerkin.name: Leather Jerkin
lw_leather_jerkin.craft_message: You craft a simple jerkin from soft leather. It's comfortable and protective.

lw_leather_boots.name: Leather Boots
lw_leather_boots.craft_message: You craft boots from soft leather with a fir wood sole. They're comfortable and ready for long walks.

lw_leather_bracers.name: Leather Bracers
lw_leather_bracers.craft_message: You craft protective wrappings from soft leather and secure them with tin buckles. These will save your wrists more than once.

lw_leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
lw_leather_armor.craft_message: You craft quality leather armor with double-stitched seams. This will serve well in the field.

lw_hardened_leather.name: Hardened Leather
lw_hardened_leather.craft_message: The sandroot infuses the tanning process, making the leather dense and strong. This will protect well.

lw_hardened_leather_armor.name: Hardened Leather Armor
lw_hardened_leather_armor.craft_message: This armor is a work of art. The hardened leather is strong, the stitching is precise. This will protect its wearer well.

lw_reinforced_leather.name: Reinforced Leather
lw_reinforced_leather.craft_message: You stitch overlapping plates of scarab chitin into the hardened hide. It flexes like leather and turns a blade like stone.

lw_reinforced_leather_armor.name: Reinforced Leather Armor
lw_reinforced_leather_armor.craft_message: Chitin, leather and bronze rivets work together perfectly, creating something stronger than any of them alone.

tl_thread.name: Thread
tl_thread.craft_message: You draw the silk out and spin it between your fingers. It's finer than any wool and stronger than it looks.

tl_woven_cloth.name: Woven Cloth
tl_woven_cloth.craft_message: You weave the cloth scraps together with practiced efficiency, creating a serviceable piece of fabric.

tl_simple_robe.name: Simple Robe
tl_simple_robe.craft_message: You sew a simple robe from woven cloth. It's light and comfortable, perfect for spellcasting.

tl_cloth_gloves.name: Cloth Gloves
tl_cloth_gloves.craft_message: You sew simple gloves that fit snugly. They'll improve your grip and mobility.

tl_apprentice_robe.name: Apprentice Robe
tl_apprentice_robe.craft_message: This robe is well-crafted, with careful stitching and reinforcement. It's suitable for serious spellwork.

tl_reinforced_cloth.name: Reinforced Cloth
tl_reinforced_cloth.craft_message: The sandroot extract strengthens the weave. The fabric is both beautiful and functional.

tl_mages_robe.name: Mage's Robe
tl_mages_robe.craft_message: This robe is a work of art. The reinforced cloth provides real protection, and the dyed trim is elegant.

tl_silken_cloth.name: Silken Cloth
tl_silken_cloth.craft_message: The silk is beautiful, flowing like water. This cloth is fit for nobility.

tl_archmages_robe.name: Archmage's Robe
tl_archmages_robe.craft_message: This robe is extraordinary. The silken fabric is infused with arcane power from the moonpetal essence. This is legendary.
